help: Cohort supervision: status, watch, supervise, print-launchd, resume
description: Forward one supervisor action. resume checks the host after a reboot and is a dry run unless given --yes with both --enabled and --i-accept-live-risk, because it kickstarts the supervise agent that starts the armed backend (resume exits 0 ready, 1 refused, 2 failed or refused authority).
data_root_reason: supervision paths come from launchd and the repository root

options.help: status | watch | supervise -- CMD... | print-launchd | resume [--yes --enabled --i-accept-live-risk], followed by service options
